evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: The canonical Phase 3 verdict is PHASE3_PASS_RANDOM_COMPATIBLE for the fair-random processes tested.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: Compatibility with tested diagnostics does not prove perfect randomness.

evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: One diagnostic passed its within-family BH threshold: Lotto 6/42 expanding historical frequency, mutual information 0.00368 nats per candidate, permutation p=0.00370, BH q=0.02960.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: This is a small association found in development evidence and does not establish predictive usefulness or independent replication.

evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: On chronological validation, 3D raw expanding-frequency NLL was 5.32132 versus fair 5.31989, with log-score advantage -0.00143, paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.00535, 0.00252], and Monte Carlo p=0.48555. Lotto 6/42 raw expanding-frequency NLL was 15.49795 versus fair 15.47294, with log-score advantage -0.02502, paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.04421, -0.00619], and Monte Carlo p=0.86701.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: The proper scores are validation results, not pristine locked-test evidence. Positive log-score advantage favors the non-fair model; the reported point estimates are negative.

evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: The strongest listed 6/42 shrinkage setting, beta kappa=1000, reduced the fair-baseline log-score deficit to -0.00977 but did not beat fair. Its mean hits@6 was 0.90, compared with fair observed mean 0.84 and fair expectation 0.85714.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: The secondary hit-count point estimate does not replace complete-combination proper scoring.

evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: The reported paired bootstrap intervals for previous-draw conditional-rate differences crossed zero. No bounded stationarity change point passed BH correction; the minimum reported q-value was 0.24958.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: Failure to detect these effects is not proof that all temporal dependence or nonstationarity is absent.

evidence_facts_for_adjudication.fact: Phase 5R used the 2,170-row 3D and 902-row 6/42 training partitions plus 723-row 3D and 300-row 6/42 validation partitions. Phase 5A validation had already been inspected.
evidence_facts_for_adjudication.limitation: Phase 5R validation is development evidence, not a pristine final confirmation.
